preset: code_review
ruleCount: 7
rules[7]{name,description,evaluationHint}:
  compiles_clean,TypeScript compiles with zero errors (tsc --noEmit),Run tsc --noEmit. FAIL if any errors.
  no_lint_warnings,Linter passes with zero warnings,Run the project linter. FAIL if any warnings or errors.
  tests_pass,All existing test suites pass,Run test suite. FAIL if any test fails.
  no_hardcoded_secrets,"No API keys, tokens, or passwords in code","Search for patterns like API_KEY=, token=, password=, hardcoded URLs with credentials. FAIL if found."
  error_handling_present,"Error paths are handled, not swallowed silently",Check try/catch blocks and promise chains. FAIL if errors are caught but ignored.
  follows_existing_patterns,New code follows the same patterns as surrounding code,Compare with adjacent files. FAIL if new abstractions or patterns diverge from established conventions.
  has_regression_test,Every bug fix ships with a test that would have caught it,Check if a test exists for the specific fix. FAIL if no test covers the fixed behavior.
